title: Pinching Antennas for ISAC: Waveguide Architectures, Solutions, and Future Directions
abstract: arXiv:2610.41380v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Integrated sensing and communication (ISAC) is a core design principle for sixth-generation (6G) wireless systems, yet fixed antenna geometry limits its performance. Pinching antenna systems (PASS) guide electromagnetic waves along dielectric waveguides and radiate them through position-adaptive antennas, allowing communication links and sensing observations to benefit from spatial reconfiguration. This article reviews PASS-enabled ISAC through single-waveguide, multi-waveguide, and segmented-waveguide architectures, comparing their feed structures, spatial degrees of freedom, operating protocols, and uplink/downlink support. We organize solution pathways around physics-consistent modeling, joint spatial-signal optimization, dynamic channel acquisition, and stable real-time control. A segmented waveguide-enabled pinching-antenna array (SWAN) case study demonstrates joint segment selection, antenna po?sitioning, and transmit beamforming

translated_title: 面向通感一体化的夹持天线：波导架构、解决方案与未来方向
translated_abstract: 集成感知与通信（ISAC）是第六代（6G）无线系统的核心设计原则，然而固定的天线几何结构限制了其性能。夹持天线系统（PASS）引导电磁波沿介质波导传播，并通过位置可自适应调节的天线将其辐射出去，使通信链路和感知观测均能受益于空间重构。本文从单波导、多波导和分段波导三种架构出发，综述了基于夹持天线的ISAC技术，比较了各架构的馈电结构、空间自由度、工作协议以及上下行支持能力。我们围绕物理一致性建模、空间-信号联合优化、动态信道获取以及稳定的实时控制等方向梳理了解决方案路径。一个基于分段波导的夹持天线阵列（SWAN）案例研究展示了分段选择、天线定位与发射波束赋形的联合设计。
tldr: 本文系统综述了面向6G通感一体化的夹持天线系统（PASS）的三类波导架构及关键技术路径，并通过SWAN案例展示了分段选择、天线定位与发射波束赋形的联合优化设计。
en_tdlr: This article reviews PASS-enabled ISAC across single-waveguide, multi-waveguide, and segmented-waveguide architectures, outlines solution pathways from physics-consistent modeling to real-time control, and demonstrates joint segment selection, antenna positioning, and transmit beamforming via the SWAN case study.
